headline: Petrobras Shares Shed Value Following Brazilian Presidential Election
summary: Brazil’s Petrobras fell from $159.8 billion to $135.6 billion in market value in a single session following Lula’s re-election, as the Brazilian real weakened and dividend schedules remained unchanged.
why: Petrobras is Latin America's largest state-controlled oil producer, making its share price highly sensitive to shifts in federal political leadership and fiscal policy.

impacts.name: Petróleo Brasileiro S.A.
impacts.why: Political shifts and currency depreciation erode investor confidence and market capitalization.

why_moved: Political uncertainty surrounding state intervention under a new presidential mandate directly triggers broad equity sell-offs in state-controlled enterprises.
